authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, sections 2.13 and 9
authority.requirement: HEADER current, UCS, DIM and optional dictionary positions are hard pointers (code 5). Handle code and counter are distinct; a zero-byte reference can retain the hard-pointer code.

physicalProducer.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, locally authored one-LINE DXF converted to AC1021
physicalProducer.observation: LibreDWG 0.14 independently reports zero-size code-5 references for PUCSNAME, PUCSORTHOREF, PUCSBASE, UCSNAME, UCSORTHOREF, UCSBASE, DIMLDRBLK, DIMBLK/1/2 and DIMLTYPE/1/2.

finding: The writer discarded the role of absent HEADER hard pointers by emitting code-0 nulls. Several optional dictionary fields were also produced through a misnamed soft-owner helper although section 9 identifies them as hard pointers.
change: Encode absent hard pointers with a zero-length code-5 handle, and use the same hard-pointer helper for the optional dictionary positions. This slice does not resolve missing current-reference targets or alter the separate named-object dictionary hard-owner link.

validation.coverage: For AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032, the actual HEADER handle bitstream is inspected at the version-specific current-reference, UCS, DIM and optional dictionary positions; zero-length hard pointers are exactly byte 0x50. The distinct NOD hard-owner position is excluded. Non-null table, block and linetype roles remain checked.

independentConverter.input: Scratch minimal single-LINE AC1021 with corrected non-null roles, typed hard-pointer nulls and experimental default-only current-reference bindings
independentConverter.operation: ACAD2013 DXF, recursion disabled, audit disabled
independentConverter.result: Exit status zero with only an .err reporting Invalid input; no DXF was produced.
independentConverter.interpretation: Typed nulls and experimental default-only references do not by themselves resolve the ODA rejection. The experimental hardcoded name binding was not committed.

limits: Explicit current layer/style/linetype/dimstyle bindings remain unresolved and must preserve caller-selected names.
No full-file interoperability or semantic claim follows.
